title: One Bug Relaunched My AI Agents 4,119 Times #Shorts
description:
One retry bug relaunched my coding agents 4,119 times over roughly six hours. The retry limit existed, but every replacement worker started with a clean counter.

Watch the full architecture breakdown: https://youtu.be/3iwHPYls19A

o8 is free and open source: https://github.com/hurttlocker/o8
